question: The volume of a right circular cone having a base diameter of 14 cm is 196 π cm³.Find the perpendicular height of this cone
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Radius (r)** = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 cm

**Volume (V)** = (1/3) × π × r² × h

196π = (1/3) × π × 49 × h ⇒ 196 = (49/3) × h

h = (196 × 3) ÷ 49 = 4 × 3 = 12 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ **Base Diameter** of the cone (d) = 14 cm

⇒ **Volume** of the cone (V) = 196π cm³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae9ea32d767c15e253e72a487c288db8dd19078b28dc277573776967be30f200.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **right circular cone** = (1/3) × π × r² × h

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Radius (r)** = Diameter ÷ 2 = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 cm

⇒ 196π = (1/3) × π × (7)² × h

⇒ 196π = (1/3) × π × 49 × h

⇒ 196 = (49/3) × h

⇒ h = (196 × 3) ÷ 49

⇒ h = 4 × 3

⇒ h = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The slant height (l) is the distance from the apex to any point on the base circle: l = √(r² + h²).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved surface of a right circular cone is given by the formula: CSA = πrl.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The sum of the curved surface area and the base area: TSA = πr(l + r).

Relation with Cylinder

The volume of a cone is exactly 1/3rd of the volume of a cylinder having the same base radius and height.</p
